title: Foot Washing
summary: Foot washing was a practical act of hospitality in a world of sandals, dusty roads, and reclining at meals.
background: Because it was lowly service, Jesus washing His disciples’ feet powerfully displayed humility, cleansing, love, and servant leadership.
teachingHelp: Do not treat John 13 as a random object lesson. The cultural act makes the humility of Christ more striking.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
